_meta.note: Synthesized from the adapter's own source, not captured: claude-agent-acp 0.107.0 (the v1 core). dist/session-notices.js:7-10 (clientSupportsNotices) turns notices on for a client that declares clientCapabilities.session.notices, as Crew declares it; dist/session-notices.js:11-18 (noticeUpdate) writes {sessionUpdate: notice, severity, title, description?} and dist/session-notices.js:27-44 (noticeOrTranscriptUpdate, transcriptBlock) is the blockquote agent_message_chunk a client without it is sent instead. The two warnings: dist/session-notices.js:103-110 (mcpServerStartupNotice, failed) sent by dist/v1/acp-agent.js:1321-1340 (reportMcpServerStartupFailures), and dist/session-notices.js:93-100 (informationalNotice) sent by the informational arm at dist/v1/acp-agent.js:3462-3501, a one-line warning with no description. The info: dist/async-tasks.js:324 (Task stopped by user). The modes: the session/new result's modes and its mode select, dist/session-mode.js:95-109 (configOption) and dist/session-mode.js:282-325 (buildAvailableModes, without bypass); EnterPlanMode's current_mode_update plan and then its config_option_update, dist/v1/acp-agent.js:7540-7542 through dist/session-mode.js:204-209 (publishCurrent) and dist/v1/acp-agent.js:6941-6952 (updateConfigOption), sent twice for two EnterPlanMode calls; then an approved plan's mode, dist/v1/acp-agent.js:6706-6712. Each config_option_update is cut to the mode select. The session id is synthetic and the texts are written for this corpus.
